registered: 2026-11-18 ~13:25 ET, before any of these four rules was computed on the warehouse
operator: 11/18: three BIPC charts marked 'signals for price increases' - the fast %R rising toward the slow (12:26), RSI-2 under 10 hooking up, and RSI-2 oversold together with the fast %R curling up from near -100

rules (fixed, no tuning; 1-minute SIP ba.EARLY_CURL: fast %R <= -50, slow %R >= -35, fast rising this bar (f - f_prev > 0.05) - the curl toward the slow line before the buy zone
rules (fixed, no tuning; 1-minute SIP ba.RSI2_HOOK: RSI-2 was < 10 on the previous bar and rises this bar
rules (fixed, no tuning; 1-minute SIP ba.DEEP_CURL: fast %R was <= -70 at some bar in the last 5 and has risen on each of the last 2 bars
rules (fixed, no tuning; 1-minute SIP ba.BOTH: DEEP_CURL this bar AND a RSI2_HOOK within the last 5 bars (including this one)

events: each rule fires at most once per name per 30 minutes (refractory); minutes 15-360; top-400 universe; name in the desk's admission band at the event ($20-$400, up >= 1.5% vs prior close). Information cell: the same rules with no admission band.
outcome: enter at the open of the next minute; +20 bp before -50 bp within 15 min (stop first if both), else the close at 15 min; 6 bp cost (holistic_entry.bracket)

pass_if_ALL (each rule separately, all 1.both_halves: mean net > 0 in the first and the second half of the days

comparison: every rule is also shown against the average admissible moment (holistic_entry: -6.14 bp) and the desk's pre-square signal (-6.48 bp)
after_pass: the passing rule becomes a paper entry trigger behind a switch (default off) next to the pre-square arm, replayed through the live code first, then ships (paper) under the operator's 11/18 rule
else: record; the operator's live call log is the remaining test of discretionary reading
caveats: minute bars with a fixed bracket, not the desk's trail; IEX vs SIP indicator differences (the operator charts SIP-like data)
